annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department of Health and Social Care (UK Secretary of State)
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends the Human Medicines (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019, including orphan and paediatric medicine decision procedures.
Adds the Republic of Korea to the list of countries with equivalent active-substance manufacturing standards.
Redefines 'designated standard' to include European Pharmacopoeia monographs for medical devices.
Requires manufacturers to update the Secretary of State on changes to device registration information.
Made under the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 to fix deficiencies in retained EU law.
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument (SI 2019/1385) amending the Brexit-related medicines and medical devices exit regulations to fix deficiencies in retained EU law. It adjusts orphan and paediatric medicine procedures, pharmacovigilance definitions, designated standards and device registration updates. It has no AI or robotics content.
